welcome.title: Welcome to {brand} setup wizard
welcome.sidebar_description: This wizard guides you through the initial setup of your {brand} system, helping you configure the core components required for a working PBX environment.
welcome.description_line_1: Define the essential configuration required to get your {brand} PBX up and running.
welcome.description_line_2: Advanced settings can be configured later from the administration interface.
welcome.pbx_settings_description: Configure basic PBX parameters such as country and system language.
welcome.extensions_description: Assign extensions to existing users to enable calling features within the PBX.
welcome.trunks_description: Configure physical or VoIP trunks to connect your PBX to the telephone network.
welcome.call_routing_description: Define inbound and outbound routes to manage incoming and outgoing calls.

physical_trunks.title: Physical trunks
physical_trunks.description: Configure physical trunks if your PBX connects to traditional telephony lines through a supported SIP gateway.

voip_trunks.title: VoIP trunks
voip_trunks.description: Configure VoIP trunks to enable inbound and outbound calls.
voip_trunks.description_details: You can create, edit or delete trunks later from the administration interface.

inbound_routes.title: Inbound routes
inbound_routes.description_line_1: Define how incoming calls are routed to internal destinations.
inbound_routes.description_line_2: Inbound routes are created and managed using the Visual Plan.

outbound_routes.title: Outbound routes
outbound_routes.description_line_1: Review and adjust outbound routes based on your country and available VoIP trunks.
outbound_routes.description_line_2: Calls use trunks in top-to-bottom order for each route.
